Labels.description:
Key-value string pairs attached to an existing resource container. Certain labels may be enforced via organizational policies.

* **Key:** Must be between 1 and 63 characters long (excluding an optional domain prefix). Must start and end with an alphanumeric character `[a-zA-Z0-9]` and can contain alphanumerics, dashes (-), underscores (_), and dots (.). May include an optional domain prefix up to 250 characters (a lowercase DNS subdomain containing `[a-z0-9]`, `-`, and `.`) followed by a slash (/). Total maximum key length is 314 characters.
* **Value:** Must be 63 characters or less. May be empty (""). If non-empty, must start and end with an alphanumeric character `[a-zA-Z0-9]` and can contain alphanumerics, dashes (-), underscores (_), and dots (.).

> Note: Additional naming restrictions may apply depending on your specific organization.*

LifecycleState.description:
Lifecycle state of the resource container.

| LIFECYCLE STATE | DESCRIPTION |
|----------|--------------------|
| CREATING | The creation process has been triggered. The state remains until resource manager gets notified about successful process completion. |
| ACTIVE   | Resource container can be fully used. |
| INACTIVE | Resource container usage has been disabled. |
| DELETING | The deletion process has been triggered. The state remains until resource manager gets notified about successful process completion. Afterwards, the record will be deleted. |
